$comment: Ramapo's academic school, program, department and center sites, each by its
folder on www.ramapo.edu and the name its own home page gives it, without
search-engine wording. npm run fetch:academic-sites collects every page under
these folders.
Reviewed September 26, 2026 against the home page title of every folder in the
site's sitemap (https://www.ramapo.edu/sitemap.xml), each folder's own
WordPress sitemap, and every captured page. Left out: the student office sites
(office-sites.json); faculty and staff sites (Faculty Assembly, the Faculty
Resource and Instructional Design Centers); campus initiatives (office-sites.json
keeps sustainability and the edible garden; the fair trade project is left out);
publications and podcasts (the law journal, Trillium); outside organizations hosted here (the
Eastern Economic Association, the Small Business Development Center); news and
old catalogs. Added September 26, 2026: the Berrie Center, less its past
production series, and Scholars' Day, less its archives of student
presentations. Also left out are the sites of programs that are closed or no
longer kept up, whose pages still read as current: the MA in Sustainability
Studies (mass) and the Provisional Teacher Program (ptp), which take no
applications, and the Spanish Language Studies site (major-spanish), unchanged
since about 2016 and contradicting the catalog. The program pages source keeps
their home pages where they have one. Sources collected elsewhere keep their own
pages: the program pages and the Ramapo pages they link to, the faculty
profiles, and the office sites.
skippedPages are pages in these folders that are not collected, each with the
reason: pages about individual students or alumni, test copies, past events
that read as current, faculty lists the faculty source keeps, and out-of-date
copies. skippedSections cut one section of a page (and with andLater every
section after it); a cut whose heading is no longer on the page leaves the
whole page out.
